name: 躲避指针容器
title: 躲避指针容器
description: 指针一靠近胶囊就往反方向压退，越近压得越狠，指针离开又弹簧滑回中心；半径 55% 以内记一次躲避、出圈才重新计数，躲满 patience 次就认输罢工，点击则反色抓住它 760ms 再全部复位。motion 驱动两枚 MotionValue，window 级指针监听按 rAF 合帧，zoom 折算兼容被缩放的舞台，reduced-motion 直接定住。
cardDescription: 指针一靠近就滑走，躲满次数才认输归位。

api.name: children
api.description: 自定义滑块内容；传函数时收到 { dodges, gave, caught, fleeing } 实时状态；不传渲染默认挑衅胶囊

api.name: taunts
api.description: 默认胶囊的标语堆叠，随躲避次数逐条切换

api.name: notice
api.description: 粗指针设备（触屏）下显示在场地底部的提示文字

api.name: inkColor
api.description: 胶囊前景墨色；浅色适合深底舞台

api.name: contrastColor
api.description: 被抓住反色时的文字颜色

api.name: fieldHeight
api.description: 场地高度（px）

api.name: reach
api.description: 近身时胶囊最多被压退的距离（px）

api.name: radius
api.description: 唤醒逃避力的指针半径（px），以场地中心计

api.name: falloff
api.description: 力的衰减指数，越大越贴身才发力、发力越猛

api.name: fleeDuration
api.description: 逃开时的弹簧时长（ms）

api.name: returnDuration
api.description: 滑回家的弹簧时长（ms）

api.name: returnBounce
api.description: 回家弹簧的回弹量

api.name: axis
api.description: 逃跑方向；单轴时只沿该轴躲

api.name: wall
api.description: 到墙边的处理；bounce 会把目标镜像反弹

api.name: patience
api.description: 躲满几次后认输不再逃；下限 1

api.name: disabled
api.description: 定住胶囊，不再对指针逃避

api.name: onDodge
api.description: 每记一次躲避时回调，携带累计次数

api.name: onRelent
api.description: 耐心耗尽、胶囊认输时回调一次

api.name: onCatch
api.description: 点击抓住胶囊时回调

api.name: className
api.description: 场地附加类名

api.name: style
api.description: 场地内联样式

prompt:
Implement the "DodgeField" component from zero: a pointer-play container whose pill (or any child you mount in it) slides away from the cursor the moment the cursor gets close — the closer it comes, the harder the pill presses against the far wall — and glides back to centre when the cursor leaves. It counts every successful dodge, taunts you with cycling labels, and after enough attempts (its patience) it relents: it stops fleeing, turns fully opaque and waits, unless you catch it with a click first, which pins it down in inverted colours for a moment before everything resets. Full specification follows; it must not depend on external pages, videos, images, font files, or off-the-shelf effect components. ## Structure & rendering - React 18+ driven by the motion animation library (motion/react: `motion`, `animate`, `useMotionValue`, `useMotionTemplate`, `useReducedMotion`). Two files only: DodgeField.jsx and DodgeField.css. No iframe. - Root is a `
`: position relative, display grid, place-items center, width 100%, height var(--df-height). It receives `--df-ink` (inkColor), `--df-contrast` (contrastColor), `--df-height` (fieldHeight px) as inline variables plus the caller's style/className (`--df-ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)` lives in the stylesheet). Two data flags land on the root: `data-coarse` when the device fails the `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)` media query, `data-flat` when prefers-reduced-motion is on. - Inside sits a mover `` — display inline-grid, will-change transform — whose transform is `translate(x px, y px)` built from two motion values through useMotionTemplate. All fleeing motion animates these values; the mover never remounts. The mover carries the click handler and three data flags: `data-fled="true"` while the pointer is inside the radius and the pill is not still, `data-relented="true"` when patience ran out, `data-caught="true"` while caught. - Default content (when no children are given) is a `
